WITH alameda AS (
  SELECT f.CDSCode, f."School Name", f."Free Meal Count (K-12)", f."Enrollment (K-12)",
         f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS free_rate,
         f."Charter School (Y/N)", f."Low Grade", f."High Grade"
  FROM frpm f
  WHERE f."County Name" = 'Alameda'
    AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
    AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
),
county_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(free_rate) AS avg_rate FROM alameda
),
top_school AS (
  SELECT * FROM alameda ORDER BY free_rate DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT t."School Name",
       CASE WHEN t."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 THEN 'Charter School' ELSE 'Regular School' END,
       t."Low Grade" || '-' || t."High Grade",
       CASE WHEN s."NumTstTakr" IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
            WHEN (s."AvgScrRead" + s."AvgScrMath" + s."AvgScrWrite") < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
            WHEN (s."AvgScrRead" + s."AvgScrMath" + s."AvgScrWrite") <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
            ELSE 'Above Average' END,
       t.free_rate - c.avg_rate
FROM top_school t
CROSS JOIN county_avg c
LEFT JOIN satscores s ON s.cds = t.CDSCode	----- bird -----	california_schools

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    f."School Name" AS school_name,
    s.City,
    s.Street,
    s.Zip,
    s.Phone,
    s.Website,
    s.OpenDate,
    s.StatusType,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12,
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_count_k12,
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS frpm_rate,
    sa.NumTstTakr,
    sa.AvgScrRead,
    sa.AvgScrMath,
    sa.AvgScrWrite,
    sa.NumGE1500,
    CAST(sa.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / sa.NumTstTakr AS excellence_rate
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
  LEFT JOIN satscores sa ON sa.cds = f.CDSCode
  WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
    AND f."District Name" = 'Fresno County Office of Education'
)
SELECT
  school_name,
  City,
  Street,
  Zip,
  Phone,
  Website,
  OpenDate,
  StatusType,
  enrollment_k12,
  frpm_count_k12,
  frpm_rate,
  NumTstTakr,
  AvgScrRead,
  AvgScrMath,
  AvgScrWrite,
  NumGE1500,
  excellence_rate,
  CASE
    WHEN frpm_rate > 0.75 THEN 'High FRPM'
    WHEN frpm_rate >= 0.50 THEN 'Medium FRPM'
    ELSE 'Low FRPM'
  END AS frpm_level,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY frpm_rate DESC) AS frpm_rank
FROM base
ORDER BY frpm_rate DESC	----- bird -----	california_schools

  JOIN satscores sa ON sa.cds = f.CDSCode
  WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 0

  city,
  street,
  mailing_street,
  mailing_city,
  mailing_zip,
  website,
  enrollment_k12,
  frpm_count_k12,
  frpm_rate,
  num_test_takers,
  avg_read,
  avg_math,
  avg_write,
  num_ge1500,
  pct_ge1500,
  CASE
    WHEN frpm_rate > 0.7 AND pct_ge1500 > 20 THEN 'High-performing despite high FRPM'
    WHEN frpm_rate < 0.3 AND pct_ge1500 < 10 THEN 'Low-performing despite low FRPM'
    ELSE 'Typical'

WITH vs AS (
  SELECT s.CDSCode, s.School, s.City, s.County, s.District,
         s.GSoffered, s.GSserved,
         f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment,
         f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_count,
         f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS frpm_pct,
         sa.NumTstTakr, sa.AvgScrRead, sa.AvgScrMath, sa.AvgScrWrite,
         sa.NumGE1500,
         (sa.AvgScrRead + sa.AvgScrMath + sa.AvgScrWrite) AS total_sat
  FROM schools s
  JOIN satscores sa ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode
  LEFT JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
    AND sa.AvgScrMath > 400
)
SELECT School, City, County, District, GSoffered, GSserved,
       enrollment, frpm_count, frpm_pct,
       CASE WHEN frpm_pct < 0.25 THEN 'Low Poverty'
            WHEN frpm_pct < 0.5 THEN 'Moderate Poverty'
            WHEN frpm_pct < 0.75 THEN 'High Poverty'
            ELSE 'Very High Poverty' END AS poverty_level,
       NumTstTakr, AvgScrRead, AvgScrMath, AvgScrWrite, NumGE1500,
       total_sat,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sat DESC) AS sat_rank
FROM vs
ORDER BY total_sat DESC	----- bird -----	california_schools

WITH sat AS (
  SELECT s.cds, s.sname, s.cname, s.NumTstTakr, s.AvgScrRead, s.AvgScrMath, s.AvgScrWrite,
         (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) AS total_avg
  FROM satscores s
  WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 500
),
joined AS (
  SELECT sat.sname, sat.cname, sat.NumTstTakr, sat.AvgScrRead, sat.AvgScrMath, sat.AvgScrWrite,
         sat.total_avg,
         f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS frpm_pct
  FROM sat
  JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = sat.cds
  JOIN schools sc ON sc.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
  WHERE sc.Magnet = 1
)
SELECT sname,
       cname,
       NumTstTakr,
       AvgScrRead,
       AvgScrMath,
       AvgScrWrite,
       total_avg,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_avg DESC) AS total_rank,
       frpm_pct,
       CASE
         WHEN frpm_pct < 0.25 THEN 'Low Poverty'
         WHEN frpm_pct < 0.50 THEN 'Moderate Poverty'
         WHEN frpm_pct < 0.75 THEN 'High Poverty'
         ELSE 'Very High Poverty'
       END AS poverty_level,
       CASE
         WHEN total_avg >= 1500 THEN 'Excellent'
         WHEN total_avg >= 1200 THEN 'Good'
         WHEN total_avg >= 900 THEN 'Average'
         ELSE 'Below Average'
       END AS performance_category
FROM joined
ORDER BY total_avg DESC	----- bird -----	california_schools

WITH combined AS (
  SELECT
    f.CDSCode,
    f."School Name" AS school_name,
    f."County Name" AS county,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" + f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS total_enrollment,
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS frpm_pct,
    f."Charter School (Y/N)" AS charter,
    s.NumTstTakr,
    s.NumGE1500,
    s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite AS total_sat_score,
    CASE
      WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" >= 0.75 THEN 'High'
      WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" >= 0.50 THEN 'Medium'
      ELSE 'Low'
    END AS frpm_category
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
  WHERE f."Enrollment (K-12)" + f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 500
)
SELECT
  county,
  school_name,
  total_enrollment,
  frpm_pct,
  charter,
  total_sat_score,
  frpm_category,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY county ORDER BY total_enrollment DESC) AS enrollment_rank,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY frpm_category ORDER BY total_sat_score DESC) AS sat_rank
FROM combined
WHERE frpm_pct > 0.60
   OR (NumTstTakr > 0 AND CAST(NumGE1500 AS REAL) / NumTstTakr > 0.30)
ORDER BY county, enrollment_rank	----- bird -----	california_schools

WITH sat AS (
  SELECT cds, sname, cname,
         CAST(NumGE1500 AS REAL) / NumTstTakr AS excellence_rate
  FROM satscores
  WHERE NumTstTakr > 0
),
frpm_active AS (
  SELECT f.CDSCode, f."School Name", f."County Name",
         f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" AS free_meal,
         f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS enroll,
         CAST(f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" AS REAL) / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS free_rate
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
  WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
    AND f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 0
),
joined AS (
  SELECT fa."School Name", fa."County Name", fa.free_meal, fa.enroll, fa.free_rate,
         sat.excellence_rate
  FROM frpm_active fa
  JOIN sat ON sat.cds = fa.CDSCode
  WHERE sat.excellence_rate > 0.3
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "County Name" ORDER BY free_rate DESC) AS rnk
  FROM joined
)
SELECT "School Name", "County Name", free_meal, enroll, free_rate, excellence_rate
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY free_rate DESC
LIMIT 1	----- bird -----	california_schools

WITH joined AS (
  SELECT
    f."School Name" AS school_name,
    f."Charter Funding Type" AS funding_type,
    f."County Name" AS county_name,
    s.NumTstTakr AS num_test_takers,
    s.AvgScrRead AS avg_read,
    s.AvgScrMath AS avg_math,
    s.AvgScrWrite AS avg_write,
    s.NumGE1500 AS num_ge1500,
    CASE
      WHEN s.NumTstTakr < 50 THEN 'under 50 testers'
      WHEN s.NumTstTakr BETWEEN 50 AND 100 THEN '50-100 testers'
      WHEN s.NumTstTakr BETWEEN 101 AND 250 THEN '100-250 testers'
    END AS testing_volume_category
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
  WHERE f."Charter Funding Type" = 'Directly funded'
    AND f."County Name" = 'Fresno'
    AND s.NumTstTakr <= 250
)
SELECT
  testing_volume_category,
  COUNT(*) AS num_schools,
  AVG(avg_read) AS avg_read_score,
  AVG(avg_math) AS avg_math_score,
  AVG(avg_write) AS avg_write_score,
  AVG(num_test_takers) AS avg_num_test_takers,
  AVG(CAST(num_ge1500 AS REAL) / num_test_takers) AS avg_excellence_rate
FROM joined
GROUP BY testing_volume_category
ORDER BY testing_volume_category	----- bird -----	california_schools

WITH hs AS (
  SELECT f.*, s.Charter AS sch_charter
  FROM frpm f
  LEFT JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
  WHERE f."Low Grade" = '9' AND f."High Grade" = '12'
    AND f."County Name" = 'Amador'
),
sat AS (
  SELECT AVG(AvgScrRead) AS r, AVG(AvgScrMath) AS m, AVG(AvgScrWrite) AS w
  FROM satscores
  WHERE cds IN (SELECT CDSCode FROM hs)
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_schools,
  AVG("Enrollment (K-12)") AS avg_enrollment,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS charter_schools,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "Charter School (Y/N)" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_charter_schools,
  AVG("Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)") AS avg_poverty_rate,
  COUNT(DISTINCT "District Name") AS num_districts,
  (SELECT r FROM sat) AS avg_sat_read,
  (SELECT m FROM sat) AS avg_sat_math,
  (SELECT w FROM sat) AS avg_sat_write,
  (SELECT "School Name" FROM hs ORDER BY "Enrollment (K-12)" DESC LIMIT 1) AS largest_school,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.75 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_poverty_schools
FROM hs	----- bird -----	california_schools

  COUNT(DISTINCT b.client_id) AS client_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT b.account_id) AS account_count,

  SUM(COALESCE(i.income, 0)) AS total_income,

  ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(e.expense, 0)), 2) AS avg_expense,
  SUM(COALESCE(l.loan_count, 0)) AS loan_count,

         COUNT(loan_id) AS loan_count,
         SUM(amount) AS total_loan_amount,
         AVG(amount) AS avg_loan_amount,
         SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans,
         SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_loans
  FROM loan GROUP BY account_id
),
trans_stats AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         COUNT(trans_id) AS trans_count,
         SUM(amount) AS total_trans_amount,
         AVG(amount) AS avg_trans_amount,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credit,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal,
         MIN(date) AS first_trans_date,
         MAX(date) AS last_trans_date
  FROM trans GROUP BY account_id
),
card_stats AS (
  SELECT d.account_id,
         COUNT(cd.card_id) AS card_count,
         MAX(cd.type) AS card_type,
         MAX(cd.issued) AS card_issued
  FROM card cd JOIN disp d ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id
  GROUP BY d.account_id
)
SELECT b.client_id,
       b.gender,
       b.birth_date,
       b.account_id,
       b.frequency,
       COALESCE(ls.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
       COALESCE(ls.total_loan_amount, 0) AS total_loan_amount,
       COALESCE(ls.avg_loan_amount, 0) AS avg_loan_amount,
       COALESCE(ls.active_loans, 0) AS active_loans,
       COALESCE(ls.completed_loans, 0) AS completed_loans,
       COALESCE(ts.trans_count, 0) AS trans_count,
       COALESCE(ts.total_trans_amount, 0) AS total_trans_amount,
       COALESCE(ts.avg_trans_amount, 0) AS avg_trans_amount,
       COALESCE(ts.total_credit, 0) AS total_credit,
       COALESCE(ts.total_withdrawal, 0) AS total_withdrawal,
       ts.first_trans_date,
       ts.last_trans_date,
       COALESCE(cs.card_count, 0) AS card_count,
       cs.card_type,
       cs.card_issued,
       CASE
         WHEN COALESCE(ls.loan_count, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(cs.card_count, 0) > 0 THEN 'Loan and Card Customer'
         WHEN COALESCE(ls.loan_count, 0) > 0 THEN 'Loan Customer'
         WHEN COALESCE(cs.card_count, 0) > 0 THEN 'Card Customer'
         ELSE 'Regular Customer'

FROM base b

LEFT JOIN card_stats cs ON cs.account_id = b.account_id
ORDER BY COALESCE(ts.total_trans_amount, 0) DESC	----- bird -----	financial

WITH low AS (
  SELECT T1.Segment AS Segment, T1.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(T2.Consumption) AS total
  FROM customers T1
  JOIN yearmonth T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
  WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK' AND T2.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
  GROUP BY T1.Segment, T1.CustomerID
),
mins AS (
  SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS m FROM low GROUP BY Segment
),
avgc AS (
  SELECT low.Segment AS Segment, AVG(low.total) AS avg_cons
  FROM low JOIN mins ON low.Segment = mins.Segment AND low.total = mins.m
  GROUP BY low.Segment
)
